book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu alongalela kuyonangeka kwa Nyumba jaka Chapanga
Yesu akabhokiki pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na paakabhi abhoka, bhabhulwa bhaki bhakanjendili kundangiha machengu gha Nyumba jaka Chapanga.
Yesu akabhayangiki, akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mughabhona ghokapi aghagha? Numpwaghi chakaka, ngalihighalili liganga panani ja liganga lelibya ngachelibombuliwe.”
Kulagha na Mang'ahiku

Hata paakabhi atami pachitombi cha Mizeituni, bhabhulwa bhaki bhakanjendi kwa kulihiya, bhakapwaghaje, “Tupwaghilaje, bho, mambu ghanihagha ghibya lile? Na jombi nde kyani nginyulila jejilangiha kuhika kwaku, na ujomukelu wa ndema?”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Ndingalyaje, mundu ngaankolowa.
Kwa ndandi bhandu bhamaheli anabhahika kwa lihina langu, bhakapwaga, ‘Nepani nde Kristo!’ Na bhombi anabhakoluwa bhandu bhamaheli.
Nanamu mwijowana ngondu, na majojalanelu gha ngondu, ndingalya ngamwijoghopa, ndandi ghanihagha ghapalika kupitalila, nambu ujomukelu ghola wakona.

Kwa ndandi bhandu bha inchi jimu anabhabhoka kujenda kukomana na bhandu bha inchi jenge, na ukolongwa kukomana na ukolongwa ghongi, kwibya na injala, na hitamu ya kujambukila, na hinyukunyuku ya luhombe pandu patalipatali.
Ghanihagha ghokapi ghibya nde ngati utumbulilu wa mabinilu ghaka mabhu joabhi na chitumbu joapala kulibhopola mwana.”
“Chikahi chenihechi anabhung'anambukya mpata mang'ahiku na kukomakeka, nanamu mwibya bhandu bha kuhakaliwa na bhandu bha inchi yokapi kwa ndandi ja lihina langu.
Pa chikahi chenihechi bhandu bhamaheli anabhauleka uhobhalelu wabhu, na bhitenda kung'anambukana, na kuhakalilana bheni kwa bheni.
Bhalota bhamaheli bhicholi anabhapitalyaje, na kubhakolowa bhandu bhamaheli.
Kwa ndandi ja kujonjukeka mahakau, upalu wa bhandu bhamaheli anaupolaje.
Nambu joanahinakalya mbaka lichobha la kujomukela, jonihoju nde joanakengaliwaje.
Kabheti Malobhi Manyahi gha Ukolongwa waka Chapanga anaghatangazwa kwa bhandu bhokapi pundema, nahuli ubya ulandilu kwabhu, panihapa nde ujomukelu ghola pawihikaje.”
Lihakalilu la uyonangeku
“Bhela, panihapa pamwalibhola, ‘Lihakalilu la uyonangeku,’ lela lelalongaliki na mlota Danieli, lijemiki pandu pahuhu mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga, joasoma na amanyaje!
Panihapa joabhi ku Yudea na atililaje ku hitombe.
Joabhi panani ja chihaghala cha nyumba jaki, ngaihuluka kutola chindu munyumba jake.
Joabhi kungonda na ngaikelabuka kunyuma kutola ingobhu jake.
Anabhang'ahikaje namaa akambomba bhabhabhi na hitumbu, na bhabhajongeha mu machobha ghanihagha!
Ndobhaje kwaka Chapanga, nahuli kutila kwinu ngakwikubha chikahi cha imbepu, wala Lichobha la Sabato.
Ndandi chikahi chenihechi kwibya na ulale ukolongwa, ngacheulabhali kubha kutumbu pa kubhombakeka kwa ndema mbaka lalenu, wala ngawipitalili kabheti.
Ngati Chapanga ngaakapungwizi machobha ghanihagha nga mundu jokapi joakakengaliki, nambu machobha ghanihagha ghatehi kupunguzwa kwa ndandi ja bhala bhabhahaghulike.”
“Bhela, mundu anaampwaghili, ‘Kristo abhi pambane’ au ‘Abhi pala,’ ngamwanhobhalela.

Kwa ndandi anabhapitalya aka ‘Kristo’ bha ichole na bhalota bha ichole, na bhitenda nginyulila ikolongwa na ngangachu yamaheli nahuli bhakoluwaje, anaiwezakini, hata kubhakolowa bhahaghulika bhaka Chapanga.
Njowanyaje, nyomwi kumpwaghila mangani ja chikahi kuhika mambu ghaghipitalyaje kulongi.”
“Bhela, anabhumpwaghili, ‘Ndingalyaje, Kristo abhi kulipololu,’ ngamwijenda konihoko, au ‘Ndingalyaje, alihiiki mkati,’ ngamwihobhalela.
Kwa ndandi, ngati bhela unang'anu wa chitobhi mochimulakila kuhuma kolipita lyobha mbaka kolijibhi lyobha, bhenibhela nde mokwibhelila kuhika kwaki Mwana waka Mundu.
“Pala paubhi ntuhi, panihapa nde payalibhongana ngwahe.”
Kuhika kwaka Mwana waka Mundu

“Palapala pakwijomuka kulagha kwa machobh ghanihagha, lyobha analijeghalika lwihi, lubhalamwehi ngalwinang'ani, ndondwa anaihabhukaje kuhuma kunani kumahunde, na makili gha hindu ya kunani kumahunde anaghanyuhakikaje.

Kabheti, nginyulila jaka Mwana waka Mundu anajibhonikanaje kunani kumahunde, na panihapa makabila ghokapi pundema ghitenda kuombuleza, na anabhumbona Mwana waka Mundu akahelala panani ja mahundi gha kunani kumahunde akabya na makili na ulumbalilu ukolongwa.

Sauti ngolongwa ja lipenga anajijowanikaje, najombi anaabhatuma bhatumika bhaki bha kunani kumahunde, na bhombi anabhabhongana bhandu bhahaghulika bhaki kuhuma ipambala yokapi nchechi ya ndema, kutumbula ujomukelu aghoghu wa ndema mbaka ujomukelu ghonge.”
Ulenganesu wa nkongu wa mtini
“Kwa nkongu wa mtini mulibhola ulenganesu aghogho. Chikahi pela mahamba ghaki paghatumbu kutundulila na kupiha mahamba, mmanya kubha chikahi cha mahunu chiheghalile.
Bhelabhela nanamu pamwibhona mambu ghanihagha ghokapi ghahengakeka, mmanya kubha chikahi chibhi pambipi nakanope kuhika.
Numpwaghi chakaka, kibheleku chenjenu ngachipeti panga mambu aghagha kupitalila.
Kunani na pundema anaipetaje, nambu malobhi ghangu ngaghipeti ng'o.”
Nga joamanya lichobha wala lisaa
“Nambu, lichobha heli na lisaa heli, nga mundu joamanya libya lile, wala bhatumika bha kunani kumahunde, wala Mwana, nambu Atati kanjika jaki nde joamanya.
Kwa ndandi ngati mokwabheli chikahi chaka Nuhu, bhenibhela nde mokwibhelila kuhika kwaki Mwana waka Mundu.

Kwa ndandi chikahi chenichela mangani ja ndema kutwelakeka machi, bhandu bhakabhi bhakakulaje na kunywa, bhakatoghulaje na kutoghuleka, mbaka Nuhu paajingili mkati ja sitima ngolongwa jejilowakeka safina.
Ngachebhamanyi chibhi kyane mbaka machi paghatwelile pundema, na kubhajola bhokapi. Nde mokwibhelila chikahi cheanahika Mwana waka Mundu.
Chikahi chenihechi bhandu bhabheli bhibya kungonda, jumu anaatolikaji na jongi kuhighalila.
Akamabhu bhabheli bhibya bhayagha ulehi, jumu anaatolakikaje, na jongi kuhighalila.
“Bhela, mulilingalyaje na kubha tayale, kwa ndandi ngachemmanya lichobha leanahika Bambo winu.
Nambu nkombuka lijambu alele. Ngati mweni nyumba akamanyiki lichobha mwihi leanahikaje, akabya atemi mihu ikilu kelukelu, wala ngaakajilekiki nyumba jaki jibombulikaje.
Bhela, nanamu bhelabhela mbya tayale, kwa ndandi Mwana waka Mundu anahika chikahi changa kuchihobhalela.”
Mtumika ndongwana au jwangakubha ndongwana
Yesu akajendali kupwagha, “Bho, nde nane mtumika ndongwana na mweni malangu, jola ambaju bambo waki anaambeka kubhajemalela bhandu bhaki, abhapekya chilebhi kwa chikahi chake?
Apengaliki mtumika jola, ambaju bambo waki paanahikaje anaanketanya akatenda bhenibhela.
Numpwaghi chakaka, anaambeka mtumika hoju ajemalya hindu yaki yokapi.
Nambu ngati mtumika muhakau anaalipwaghi muntima jaki, ‘Bambo wangu akabhakili kukelabhuka,’
kabheti na kutumbula kubhalapu bhatumika bhajake, akatumbula kula na kunywa papamu na bhabhalobhe uwembi,
bambo waki anahika lichobha langa kuliholalela, na lisaa langa kulimanya.
Panihapa nde anaantemula nakanopi mundu hoju, na kumbeka papamu na lipogha la akandumila kubheli, konihoku nde kwibya kulela na kuyagha mino.
